title: KTL-002: Measured KB learning with separate interactive and Builder lanes
description: Corrective proving initiative. Builder remains autonomous and interactive tools never consume its queue through bare next. Session-end records append-only KB effectiveness receipts. This initiative supersedes the workflow-boundary packets in ktl-001-leverage-and-learning-v1; it does not supersede that manifest's independent reuse, evidence, capability, Product Studio, Agent Canvas, model-bench, or Mission-projection work.

packets.title: Prove bare next cannot consume Builder work
packets.objective: Verify across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex that bare next continues only the current interactive assignment, uses Builder only for collision/status awareness, and cannot apply initiatives, claim/select/run packets, or drain the queue. Explicit builder next and valid Builder-launched bundles remain governed Builder entrypoints. Every implementation records exactly one execution owner.
acceptance_criteria: A valid interactive checkpoint continues without using Builder as a task source
No interactive checkpoint produces an explicit no-op and leaves queued Builder tasks unchanged
Explicit builder next or a valid Builder bundle enters Builder without changing bare next semantics
Reviewing Builder output does not transfer implementation ownership
All repo entry instructions agree on the same execution-owner boundary

packets.title: Measure KB retrieval, efficiency, and accepted quality
packets.objective: Verify the append-only effectiveness receipt and rolling report. Record one execution owner, consulted/used/stale entries, canonical promotions, and only evidence-backed token, cost, elapsed, attempt, repair, regression, and independent-review values. Unknowns stay null; cohort comparison is observational and cannot claim causation.
acceptance_criteria: Identical receipts are idempotent and conflicting session identities fail
Unknown fields, invalid entry subsets, corrupt history, blank lines, and receipt-ID mismatches fail loudly
Unknown token/time/cost/quality values remain unknown rather than zero
Summary reports retrieval usefulness/staleness, evidence coverage, efficiency, first-pass approval, regressions, avoided duplication/corrections, and canonical promotions
Report marks cohorts observational and sample sizes insufficient when thresholds are not met
Session-end writes one receipt without creating issues, recommendations, roadmap work, or Builder tasks

packets.title: Prove autonomous Builder and interactive continuity in parallel
packets.objective: Run a zero-cost non-destructive proof with two separate lanes. Builder independently selects and executes one approved packet through validation and review. In parallel, an interactive tool receives bare next, continues only its own checkpoint, and session-end writes execution_owner=interactive plus an effectiveness receipt. Prove neither lane claims, duplicates, schedules, or reports the other's implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Builder progresses without an interactive bare-next instruction
Bare next leaves Builder task identities and leases unchanged
Each implementation has exactly one execution owner
Builder attempt/review evidence and interactive continuity/effectiveness evidence remain separate but cross-referenced
A second interactive tool resolves the same valid interactive continuation rather than completed Builder work
The final report names unavailable measurements and makes no causal token/quality claim
